prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop app composition for Byori, a native macOS multi-agent coding workspace
Primary request: Create COMPOSITION C, a source-tree-first first viewport for a real native macOS SwiftUI app. The product hierarchy is Project → Source Tree or Worktree → Task → Session. The user chooses exactly one coding agent and model for each session, and the choice is fixed. Switching agents means opening another session, not broadcasting a task.
Scene/backdrop: one full macOS app window shown straight-on, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no surrounding desk
Subject: a three-column Byori workspace optimized for navigating several worktrees. Left: a 290px structured outline headed "Projects", project "byori" expanded. Under a clear "Source Trees" group show primary tree "main" and managed worktree "workspace-ui"; beneath "workspace-ui" show task "Build workspace" and selected session "Codex · gpt-5.6". Include a compact branch/dirty status next to source trees, a "New Session" action near the selected task, and Settings at bottom. Center: a large dark real interactive terminal for the selected session, with a slim header showing breadcrumb "byori / workspace-ui / Build workspace", the fixed "Codex · gpt-5.6" metadata, running status, and Stop action. Right: a 320px inspector with tabs "Files", "Git", and "Context"; Files is active and shows a native outline tree for folders "manager", "cli", "mcp", "tests" and files "PRODUCT.md", "README.md". A small collapsed ByoriDB context disclosure sits at the inspector bottom, not a second main navigation.
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity native macOS SwiftUI product interface; standard title bar and traffic lights; system typography, SF Symbols-like icons, native outline/list controls; subtle materials and crisp separators; restrained density
Composition/framing: 16:10 landscape, one full application viewport; readable 290px hierarchy / dominant terminal / 320px file inspector
Lighting/mood: calm operational light macOS chrome with a dark terminal; precise, durable, developer-focused
Color palette: white and soft gray app chrome, near-black terminal, restrained teal selection/running accent, semantic amber only for dirty worktree
Text (verbatim): "Byori", "Projects", "Source Trees", "byori", "main", "workspace-ui", "Build workspace", "Codex · gpt-5.6", "New Session", "Running", "Stop", "Files", "Git", "Context", "manager", "cli", "mcp", "tests", "PRODUCT.md", "README.md", "ByoriDB context", "Settings"
Constraints: show only one active terminal; make source tree versus task versus session nesting unmistakable; worktree status is metadata, not a dashboard; no agent switcher inside a running session; all core labels readable; Settings remains separate
Avoid: auto fan-out, side-by-side agent terminals, combined agent timeline, agent ranking, dashboard cards, rounded web-app panels, excessive badges, gradients, purple neon, copied Orca or Paseo identity, chat bubbles, marketing copy, fake metrics, watermarks
